jobs.title: Mobility and Compliance Lead
jobs.description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose We are looking for a Mobility and Compliance Lead to be the champion of mobility policy and compliance across Neko as we scale. You will make sure that everyone who joins Neko from another country, relocates between our locations, or works across borders for us can do so lawfully and with a seamless experience, and that the business is never exposed to right-to-work, immigration or cross-border employment risk. This role sits at the point where detail meets people. You will get into the detail of immigration rules, relocation packages and cross-border obligations, and you will be the visible, reassuring face of mobility for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders. When the answer is no, or not by that date, you will say so clearly, explain why, and show what the compliant alternatives are. You will lead through ownership, expertise and influence, working closely with People Enablement, Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal and our external advisers. Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique. Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition. La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle : c’est le socle de notre crédibilité vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons. Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
